Reviewing the plan and tracing the cited code paths for contract gaps.
schema_version	scope	severity	focus_area	location	what	scenario_or_breakage	suggested_fix
1	in_scope	important	correctness	skills/bug/SKILL.md:21-48	The plan adds `--urgent` parsing in the Contract and `--title-prefix` in Step 5 but does not require stripping leading `--urgent` tokens before Step 1 security triage or the empty-description gate.	`/bug --urgent SQL injection in auth` still runs Step 1 security triage on raw `$ARGUMENTS` (flag text first). `/bug --urgent` alone can fail the empty check for the wrong reason or skip investigation of the real description. Item 4 acceptance breaks.	Add an early argv-normalization step (before Step 1): strip all leading `--urgent` tokens, bind `BUG_DESCRIPTION`, run Step 1 empty check and security triage on `BUG_DESCRIPTION`, use it in Steps 3-4, and pass `--title-prefix` only in Step 5.
1	in_scope	important	architecture	python/pr_body.py:16-30	The plan says to reuse `oos_filer._FILED_URL_LINE_RE` for Item 1 JSON parsing. That couples run-summary rendering to the OOS filing module via a private regex.	Implementers may `import oos_filer` from `pr_body.py`, widening the dependency surface and inviting drift if filing grammar changes independently.	[SCOPE-REDUCTION] Duplicate the filed-URL line regex inline in `pr_body.py` (or lift one shared compiled pattern to `config.py`) instead of importing `oos_filer` private symbols.
1	out_of_scope	latent	risk-integration	python/step_7a.py:291-298	Item 3 makes execution-issues warnings the primary durable diagnostic, but Step 7a still skips `_run_log_flush` when the 7a.r rebase probe fails.	On diagram failure plus rebase conflict/failure, enriched warnings and the copied `code-flow-diagram.failure.log` stay in the tmpdir and never reach committed `execution-issues.ndjson` or repo `larch-logs/`. This gap predates the plan; stdout `DIAGRAM_REASON` alone is ephemeral.	File a follow-up to flush execution-issues (and staged failure logs) on `LOG_FLUSH_STATUS=skipped-rebase-checkpoint`, or document that diagram diagnostics are only guaranteed when 7a.r succeeds.
1	out_of_scope	nit	architecture	skills/implement/scripts/step-7a.md:18-27	The plan adds `DIAGRAM_REASON` to Step 7a KV output but does not update the shipped stdout contract doc.	Operators and harness authors reading `step-7a.md` will not know the new key exists; only `python/test_step_7a.py` will catch regressions.	Add `DIAGRAM_REASON` to the KV table in `skills/implement/scripts/step-7a.md` when implementing Item 3.
